subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in missing-argument prompt contract for native commands, and should Telegram map that contract to ForceReply for commands such as /btw and /steer?
rationale: The requested behavior changes native command semantics and may need command registry, plugin SDK, or channel presentation metadata instead of a Telegram-only special case.

options.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
options.body: Define a narrow command-level prompt descriptor, enable it only for selected missing freeform-argument commands, and implement Telegram ForceReply as the channel mapping.

options.title: Keep usage-only behavior
options.body: Leave bare menu taps as usage replies until a broader native-command prompt design is approved.

options.title: Prototype in Telegram only
options.body: Add a small Telegram-local allowlist for ForceReply while accepting possible drift from command metadata and other native surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
recommendation.body: Define a narrow command-level prompt descriptor, enable it only for selected missing freeform-argument commands, and implement Telegram ForceReply as the channel mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main history routes the native command and command-registry surface through this recent PR author/merger.
